POP-ERR-09.title: This route is already completed in MES (498 lan)
POP-ERR-09.root_cause: Cong doan da duoc chot hoan thanh tren MES WinForm hoac luot truoc, WinForm chan ghi de tu Kiosk
POP-ERR-09.fast_fix: Dung Golden Query .\mes.ps1 trace '<Lot>' kiem tra STB_ProdRouteHist. Xoa luot ket cu qua Template 3 hoac chuyen cong doan tiep theo

POP-ERR-16.title: Tem thung in tu POP bi co ngan ma vach PackingID (Scanner khong doc duoc)
POP-ERR-16.root_cause: Kiosk POP thieu engine sinh PackingID chuan 11 ky tu (PKQR1900142). DevExpress AutoModule=true lam co cum thanh vach Code 128
POP-ERR-16.fast_fix: Chay template sql/template_GENERATE_POP_PACKING_ID.sql hoac in lai tren WinForm B523/B528

POP-ERR-19.title: Khong tim thay LOT trong kho khi nap cuon dien cuc / BOM
POP-ERR-19.root_cause: Kho chua quet xuat kho tren WMS hoac kho luu tru khong khop voi Line kho
POP-ERR-19.fast_fix: Kiem tra STB_MaterialLotInfo.MaterialWarehouseCode va StockQty tren STB_MaterialStock

POP-ERR-20.title: Kiosk thieu thiet bi / An may tai modal Xac nhan Ket thuc
POP-ERR-20.root_cause: May bi ket status MAPPING_STATUS='ACTIVE' tu DayPlan cu trong VINA_EQUIPMENT_MAPPING do OP khong bam Huy gan

POP-ERR-21.title: Ma loi phe tren POP Kiosk khong hien hoac STB_SetInfo.DefectQty bi thieu
POP-ERR-21.root_cause: Three-Valued Logic: Cot IsDelete va RepairQty bi NULL do thieu constraint default trong STB_DefectRepairInfo
POP-ERR-21.fast_fix: Chay Template 11 (POP_KB_03): UPDATE STB_DefectRepairInfo SET IsDelete='0', RepairQty=0 WHERE ControlNo='<ControlNo>' AND (IsDelete IS NULL OR RepairQty IS NULL)

POP-ERR-22.title: Already transferred to MES. Cannot modify (162 lan)
POP-ERR-22.root_cause: Ban ghi san luong hoac phe da duoc luong ngam dong bo sang MES (IsTransferred=1), Kiosk khoa quyen sua/xoa
POP-ERR-22.fast_fix: Bao IT dieu chinh truc tiep tren MES WinForm hoac chay Hotfix rollback/update bọc BEGIN TRAN...ROLLBACK

POP-ERR-23.title: 실적이 없는 공정입니다. 실적 등록 후 추가하세요 (120 lan)
POP-ERR-23.root_cause: Chua dang ky san luong tot (Good Qty) ma da bam them phe pham hoac ket thuc cong doan
POP-ERR-23.fast_fix: Nhap so luong san xuat tot truoc vao o yangpum (Good Qty), sau do moi mo modal phe pham va bam Hoan tat

POP-ERR-24.title: This roll has already been used for 2 product LOTs. Input blocked (100 lan)
POP-ERR-24.root_cause: Rang buoc toan ven nghiep vu: 1 cuon BTP dien cuc chi duoc phep cat/nap toi da cho 2 LOT san pham, quet vao LOT thu 3 bi chan
POP-ERR-24.fast_fix: Doi sang cuon dien cuc moi chua vuot qua 2 LOT. Khong co quet ep cuon da dung du dinh muc

POP-ERR-25.title: 코팅 생산수량 등록 후 불량등록이 가능합니다 (73 lan)
POP-ERR-25.root_cause: Trinh tu bat buoc tai cong doan Coating: He thong yeu cau phai ghi nhan chieu dai Coating truoc khi dang ky phe
POP-ERR-25.fast_fix: Nhap met mang Coating tot truoc, sau do moi bam dang ky cac ma phe pham me tron/trang phu

POP-ERR-26.title: 작업자를 먼저 지정해 주세요 (60 lan)
POP-ERR-26.root_cause: Chua chon hoac chua quet the nhan vien kiem tra (Inspector) truoc khi luu bien ban PQC/In-Line QC
POP-ERR-26.fast_fix: Quet the nhan vien hoac chon ma cong nhan kiem tra tai o Inspector truoc khi bam Luu

POP-ERR-27.title: 믹싱 공정이 완료되지 않았습니다 (40 lan)
POP-ERR-27.root_cause: Me tron Mixing chua nap du 100% cac ma NVL theo dinh muc recipe (con ton dong NVL chua quet)
POP-ERR-27.fast_fix: Mo danh sach NVL Mixing, quet bo sung day du cac ma NVL con thieu roi moi chot san luong Coating

POP-ERR-28.title: 호일 부족: 코팅 생산수량 > 투입 호일 가용 길이 (15 lan)
POP-ERR-28.root_cause: Can bang vat tu: Chieu dai mang Coating dang ky vuot qua tong chieu dai la Foil kim loai da nap vao may
POP-ERR-28.fast_fix: Quet nap them cuon Foil kim loai bo sung vao o NVL de bu dap chieu dai thieu hut
